name: Miles Welsh
summary: In the Pools of Vision, Miles Welsh teaches priests beneath Thunder Bluff. The Forsaken trainer offers spiritual instruction and shadow discipline in the tauren capital.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Caverns
sections.body: Miles Welsh teaches priests in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. Far from Lordaeron's plague-scarred ruins, the Forsaken priest makes his home in the grotto beneath the city. He instructs travelers in divine and shadowy energies. His place in the heart of Mulgore reflects the tenuous ties between the Forsaken and the Horde. There, he shares sanctuary with tauren mystics and shamans while guiding acolytes in shadow and faith.

faq.answer: Miles Welsh trains priests in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. He helps Horde priests with their training and specialized disciplines.

faq.q: Where can I find Miles Welsh?
faq.answer: Find Miles Welsh in the Pools of Vision, the caverns beneath the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Enter through a cave entrance on the mesa.

faq.q: Why is an undead priest trainer in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The Forsaken and tauren are allies in the Horde. Magatha Grimtotem advocated for the Forsaken to join, allowing emissaries and trainers like Miles Welsh to serve in Mulgore.
Miles Welsh teaches general priest spells. He also helps Forsaken and troll acolytes seeking specialized racial teachings such as Touch of Weakness or Shadowguard.

angles.text: As a priest traveling through Kalimdor, you can study new spells and advance your spiritual training with Miles Welsh, one of the few such teachers in central Horde territory.
As an undead traveler, you may find Miles Welsh a familiar, cold face in the earthy, sun-drenched tauren capital.
